verdict.rationale: A native mobile app is a fair question for a workspace and task tool, but no first-party evidence documents a Notion mobile app or parity with desktop. The only mobile-related items are community comments describing problems: mobile login being unusable without email, difficulty getting content out on mobile, and a gap in offline/mobile-first support. These suggest some mobile use exists but provide no evidence of a full-featured native app without missing desktop functionality.
